newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco feed group to seek 20,000 tonnes of maize.
newsitem.headline: Morocco feed group to seek 20,000 tonnes of maize.

text.p: Moroccan feedstuffs group AFAC is to tender for 20,000 tonnes of maize, probably next week, a group spokesman said on Tuesday.
"Yes, we are going to tender for 20,000 tonnes but the date is not yet fixed. It will probably be next week," the spokesman for the Association des Fabricants d'Aliments Composes (AFAC) said.
Another AFAC official said the date for the tender would be fixed at the end of this week.
No decision had yet been made on delivery dates.
